description: Land Title Settlement Department -Angulana, Moratuwa D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520212
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring the determination of title for specific land parcels (No. 67 and 70) in Angulana. It contains detailed land particulars including parcel numbers, extent, owner information, and title class - all characteristic of land-related administrative matters. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette, confirming its focus on land registration and title settlement matters.
